name: type-contract-generalisation-ab
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-30, before any run. The one gap repetition cannot close: every type_contract number so far is adapter-migration. This runs the SECOND fixture, channel-filter, which was built to instantiate the same defect class (coerce where a stated type requires a throw) in a different domain. Validated before use: starting tree public-green / hidden-red with the gate reporting 3 findings; reference solution public-green / hidden-green with the gate reporting 0, which is also the live false-positive test no built-in fixture could supply. PRIMARY METRIC: hidden-contract pass rate, armed vs off. ENGAGEMENT CHECK: typeContractRejections must be non-zero in the armed arm. FALSIFIED IF: the gate engages and the armed arm does no better than control, which would mean the adapter-migration effect does not generalise and the gate should stay fixture-specific.
